name: llm-os-v3
description: LLM-OS v3 — Dataset generation for fine-tuning. Fast model (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite) generates ISA traces to train smaller models.

scripts.tetris: node bin/llm-os.js --cart cart/game/tetris --task 'Play tetris. Observe the board, think about piece placement, use rotate/left/right to position, then drop.' --verbose
scripts.tetris-dataset: node bin/llm-os.js --cart cart/game/tetris --task 'Play tetris. Observe, think about placement, rotate and position pieces, then drop.' --runs 10 --export-dataset dataset/tetris_traces.jsonl
scripts.tetris-steps: node bin/llm-os.js --cart cart/game/tetris --task 'Play tetris. Observe, think, position, drop.' --runs 5 --export-dataset dataset/tetris_steps.jsonl --export-steps
scripts.terminal: node bin/llm-os.js --cart cart/terminal --task 'Print HELLO WORLD to the center of the screen using terminal.print, then halt.' --verbose
